gap: No result ChatGPT got prices the whole USB/XLR field on one day: Fifine AM8 $57.99 and Maono PD200X $80.99 at their makers' stores, Samson Q2U $99.99 and Q9U $149.99 at SoundPro, Maono PD400X $154.99 at Maono, RØDE PodMic USB $209 at Micheo Music and Shure MV7+ $255 at SoundPro. None of those results notes either that Samson's own Q9U page shows the mic as 'Coming Soon' and unavailable.
standout_why: Both cited MusicRadar pages (best-podcasting-microphones and best-usb-microphones) returned only their titles to WebFetch (128 characters of text), so I couldn't check their prices. Itechguides (rank 8, read 2026-11-17) prices only the Fifine AM8 ($56.99, Amazon). It gives no price for the MV7+, PodMic USB, Q9U or any Maono, and nothing about Q9U availability. ChatGPT's answer named only three mics, priced at $255 / $190 / $149.99. It left out every hybrid under $149.99, and it left out the Maono PD400X, which costs less than the PodMic USB.
decides: This changes the 'Best value' pick. ChatGPT made the PodMic USB its value pick at $190, but the cheapest retailer price I opened today was $209 at Micheo Music. Maono's store has the PD400X (XLR + USB-C, 0 to +42 dB gain) at $154.99. The MV7+ at $255 at SoundPro matches ChatGPT's card and stays the premium pick. The Q9U is $149.99 at SoundPro, but Samson's own page shows it as Coming Soon / unavailable, so it is a weak budget pick. Under $100, the Fifine AM8 ($57.99), Maono PD200X ($80.99) and Samson Q2U ($99.99) all have both outputs.
